name: Counter then accept fridge→DHW offer
description: Typed multi-round procedure⇄thermal: first power band min exceeds the fridge condenser max (plant Counters with suggested 120 W). accept_counter=true auto-reoffers the suggested band and accepts. Requires SimulatorBackend + ThermalPlant (fridge_condenser_dhw_demo). Contrast offer_fridge_dhw_soft (fallback_power_w after Counter/Decline). Dedicated thin wasm UI: simulator-web Thermal procedures + run_thermal_procedure.
